candidate_workaround: Resolve the selected skill directory first and invoke its bundled runner from the exact discovered scripts path instead of assuming repository materialization.
failure_signature: A repository scripts lookup returned no Method Flow runner because the runner belongs to the selected skill package.
recurrence_guard: When a skill documents a bundled runner, resolve the skill root and scripts directory before constructing a repository-relative command.
rollback: Give the empty repository lookup zero runner-discovery credit and inspect only the selected skill package.
scope_boundary: Owner-local skill-runner discovery only; no broad filesystem, production, or independent-reproduction claim.
title: Resolve bundled runner paths from the selected skill root
